text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The deserted island development plan had 
reached a milestone. So, to reward 
everyone for their hard work up to now—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Time to feast!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
To your dedication, and to your honed 
bodies and minds! Let us eat, drink, and 
make merry to our hearts' content!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I agree! Ah, I have a suggestion though. 
How about we throw a party using stuff 
from the island!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"That's a great idea! I've gotten pretty 
used to foraging over the past three 
years! I can even make things like 
tables!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"When in the mountains, become the 
mountain," right?! Let's show off the 
fruits of that at this party!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Right. Then let's split up the tasks right 
away, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: We're on 'meal duty'... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, before we look for ingredients—

text_block_list.name: Twintail Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Sunscreen, right! Everyone's already all 
set and protected!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I brought the whole tube with me so I can 
reapply it often!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ngh, hah!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, got another one. Am I getting too 
good at catching fish?
choice_data_list: You've really adapted to the wild...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Quit phrasing it like that. Anyway, what 
about everyone else—"

text_block_list.name: Dreadlocked Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"White fish! Aim for the white fish! Let's 
get that high protein!"

text_block_list.name: Bandana-wearing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Soup's the way to go! Don't wanna catch a 
chill! I'll go get the rest of the veggies 
in the woods!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Looks fine to leave it to her. Huh? The 
soup...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Right, drinks! I'm pretty sure there were 
coconuts over—!

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I already got it down~! When it comes to 
tree climbing, you can leave it to me!
choice_data_list:
You climbed all the way up to collect 
these!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft. Aren't you getting a little *too* 
beefy?

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, yes! It's all thanks to you, 
City-san!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I talked with City-san, I've 
started paying attention to a lot of 
things. Like food and exercise.

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And then the workload was seriously 
insane. If City-san hadn't been there, I 
definitely wouldn't have kept going.

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks to you, Miss City, I've learned 
to love myself for keeping at it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Dummy. See, it's got nothing to do with me 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...You're the one who worked hard. Why not 
give yourself some credit?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, keep at it for as long as you 
can. All for the sake of 'beauty.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the party came to an end as the 
night deepened—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I got carried away and ate too 
much... Guess I'll have to adjust 
tomorrow.
choice_data_list: Maybe I should do that too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? There's no reason you need to go that 
far, you know.
choice_data_list:
If I'm going to stand beside someone as 
beautiful as you, I have to give it my 
all.

If I'm to stand beside someone as 
beautiful as you, I have to give it my 
all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, good luck to ya. Now that you've 
said it, no backing out, got it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The undeniable "strength" painstakingly 
built over time. It was a night I swore in 
my heart to be worthy of such a dazzling 
radiance.
